question:
What is the median of the following distribution?

 
 

 **Class**
 100-150
 150-200
 <td style="text-align: ce
solution:
**Formula used:**

Median = L + [(N/2 - CF)/f] × w

Where:

L = Lower boundary of median class

CF = Cumulative frequency before median class

f = Frequency of median class

w = Width of median class

**Calculation:**

Total frequency (N) = 22 + 18 + 25 + 15 + 20 = 100

Median position = N/2 = 100/2 = 50

Cumulative frequencies:

100-150: 22

150-200: 40 (22+18)

200-250: 65 (40+25)

250-300: 80 (65+15)

300-350: 100 (80+20)

Median class = 200-250 (since 50th position falls in this class)

Median = L + [(N/2 - CF)/f] × w

L = Lower boundary of median class = 200

N/2 = 50

CF = Cumulative frequency before median class = 40

f = Frequency of median class = 25

w = Width of median class = 50

⇒ Median = 200 + [(50 - 40)/25] × 50

⇒ Median = 200 + [10/25] × 50

⇒ Median = 200 + 0.4 × 50

⇒ Median = 200 + 20

**⇒ Median = 220**
